lines: Most business plans written with AI fall apart at the first hard question.
Bankable is a Claude skill, built to survive them.
It works by three rules.
Numbers come before the story.
Every claim has a source.
And nothing about your company is ever invented.
Setup takes a minute.
Upload the skill file to Claude, or clone the repository into your Claude Code skills folder.
Then describe what you need, attach whatever you have, and say who will read it.
Bankable asks at most eight questions, logs every assumption, and builds the financial model first.
Only then does it write, and test the draft the way an investor, a banker, a reviewer, and a CFO would.
Investors, banks, government reviewers, or your board.
The chapters and the metrics adapt to the reader.
You get a Word business plan, in English, Chinese, or both.
A live, three statement Excel model, with scenarios and sensitivity.
An evidence register.
And a pitch deck, all tied to the same numbers.
Correct an assumption, rerun, and every figure in the plan updates with it.
Bankable.
Business plans that survive due diligence.
